_howTo: This file is the RSVP calendar. Edit it in any text editor (or on GitHub) and the website updates; nothing else to change.
form: paste a Web3Forms access key (free, web3forms.com) OR a Formspree form link like https://formspree.io/f/abcdwxyz. RSVPs then arrive by email.
email: her email address. Used only if the form above is empty or not reachable: the visitor's email app opens with the RSVP filled in.
phone: shown everywhere for texting an RSVP (texting is preferred).
sessions: one line per session. date is YYYY-MM-DD, start/end are 24-hour Arizona time, price is per person in dollars.
capacity = most people; booked = people already RSVP'd (raise it as RSVPs come in, so the site shows the spots left).
dogs: true lets guests bring dogs; dogCapacity = most dogs; dogsBooked = dogs already RSVP'd.
To close a session, set booked to the same number as capacity. To remove one, delete its line.
